message: This element has insufficient contrast at this conformance level. Expected a contrast ratio of at least 3:1, but text in this element has a contrast ratio of 1.06:1. Recommendation:  change background to #979493.
Heading tag found with no content. Text that is not intended as a heading should not be marked up with heading tags.
selector: #main-content > section:nth-child(5) > div > div > div > div > div > div:nth-child(2) > div > h5
